newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Ericsson sees boost in mobile phone sales - paper.
newsitem.headline: Ericsson sees boost in mobile phone sales - paper.

text.p: Swedish telecoms group Ericsson expects total mobile phone sales of up to 300 million in 2000 when its own capacity could reach 50 million phones annually, daily Dagens Industri said on Friday.
"Between 200 million and 300 million mobile phones can very well be sold in 2000," Jan Ahrenbring, Ericsson's mobile phone marketing manager, was quoted as saying.
"The higher figure is possible if competition between mobile phone operators grows strong enough," he said.
Last year the market totalled about 65 million mobile phones and this year Ericsson sees it landing at around 100 million, the newspaper said.
Ericsson sold almost nine million mobile phones last year and is planning to sell at least 20 million phones this year, Dagens Industri said.
